programs.description: Afraid of getting blamed, three good friends trick everyone into thinking their boss is alive when they find his dead body. They strive to find the murderer before revealing the truth about his death.
Roby, a young man, migrates to Las Vegas in hopes of earning a livelihood and starts working at a casino. Things take a turn when he loses his friend's money and struggles with mental health issues.
Aravindan, a poor man, is forced to beg in order to collect money for his mother's liver operation. He meets Chippy, a young woman, who lives the life of a beggar with poor children.
Documentary filmmaker Aleena delves into the mysterious disappearance of the yesteryear Malayalam actress, Gracy, from the silver screen.
When Unnimol, a young girl child, faces dismissal from all her relatives and community, Lord Ayyappan takes the form of a school student to help her overcome obstacles.
A father realises his mistake after his son, whom he loves dearly, kicks him out of the house. At the time, his daughters decide to help him out despite being neglected.
After leaving his life of crime behind, Aadhi is drawn back into the drug trade by his former gang leader. However, after meeting Seema and falling in love, he decides to atone for his past mistakes.
